label: Complaint query service
instruction: Create ONE short Python file, modules/complaint_cms/services/queries.py (maximum 45 lines). It must contain exactly three MODULE-LEVEL functions and no classes: list_complaints(actor), assigned_tasks(actor), and list_notifications(actor). Enforce actor.has_permission("complaint_cms.complaint.view_self") or "complaint_cms.task.view" as appropriate and raise core.api.exceptions.PermissionDeniedError if access is not granted. Return Django QuerySets from Complaint, ComplaintTask and ComplaintNotification filtered by actor.user_id (or all complaints if actor has complaint_cms.complaint.review or complaint_cms.record.manage). Use only existing model classes and fields from modules.complaint_cms.models. Return raw Python source only without code fences.
